titulo: An American Girl - Grace Stirs Up Success
analisis: Un inglés muy familiar, optimista y educativo. Al transcurrir en una panadería y en un viaje a Francia, el vocabulario se enriquece con términos de cocina, emprendimiento y repostería, presentados de forma muy accesible para los más jóvenes.
sinopsis: Grace is excited for the summer so she can start a business with her friends, but things take an unexpected turn when her mom announces a trip to Paris. There, Grace must learn to get along with her French cousin, Sylvie, and she finds unexpected inspiration for her business. Then, Grace finds out her grandparents bakery, that inspired her to start a business, is closing. Can she and her friends find a way to save it?
